scope: Owner reviewed all 148 batch-four proposals: 129 approved main-list senses, 19 excluded from all gameplay roles from revision 19. Original review IDs and draft examples retained.
sourceAttribution: Wiktionary contributors: fixed-revision links and concise adapted glosses under CC BY-SA 4.0. Georgian explanatory dictionary at ganmarteba.ge (Linguistic Technologies Group): URL, access date and source-content hash recorded where used; full definitions are not reproduced here. See content/dictionaries/README.md.
selection: Individually selected noun/adjective senses; each candidate has a verified connected five-answer draft with four already approved words, seven tiles, at least two five/six-letter answers, valid crossings, density and phone size. Prioritize candidates with existing unused approved companions.
limitations: Owner review complete: 129 additions approved and 19 spellings rejected. Campaign use remains subject to all rules.
Individual board feasibility does not guarantee whole-campaign placement or reduced repetition under the 75-level gap, unique-wheel and pacing rules.
The board search is bounded; unselected candidates are not declared impossible.
Frequency ranks were supporting discovery evidence only; no native-speaker review is claimed.
